lyrics.label: Verse 1
lines: Before the throne of God above I have a strong and perfect plea
Great high priest whose name is Love, whoever lives and pleads for me
Graven on his hands, my name is written on his heart
I know that while in heaven He stands, no tongue can bid me thence

lyrics.label: Tag
lines: No tongue can bid me thence

lyrics.label: Verse 2
lines: When Satan tempts me to despair and tells me of the guilt within, upward I look and see Him there
Who made an end to all my sin because the sinless Savior died
My sinful soul is counted free, for God the Just is satisfied
To look on Him and pardon me
To look on Him and pardon

lyrics.label: Verse 3
lines: Behold Him there the risen Lamb, my perfect spotless righteousness
The great unchangeable I AM, the King of glory and of grace
One with Himself; I cannot die
My soul is purchased by His blood, my life is hid with Christ on high
With Christ my Savior and my God
